plan_tip.text: Stack the body: hips forward, handle low, eyes up.
Stay tucked, arms long — let the boat pull you onto plane, then stand slowly.

success_note.text: Up and riding. Settle into a quiet stance before the next lesson.

fail_note.text: Didn't get up this time. Stay tucked longer and let the boat do the work.

plan_tip.text: Get wide early, then carry a steady pull across both wakes — not a jerk.

success_note.text: Good width on most turns. Keep the same early move-out next pass.

fail_note.text: Width came up short or the pass ended early. Start the move out sooner and rebuild one buoy at a time.

plan_tip.text: Smooth pull-out, patient glide, turn-in on time — arrive wide and early for buoy 1.

success_note.text: Gates and buoy 1 made. Good start to the pass — keep that same turn-in timing.

fail_note.text: Missed the gates or buoy 1. Focus on the line through the gates first, then the first ball.

plan_tip.text: Start the turn before the buoy, peak the lean at the buoy, and finish before you pull.

success_note.text: Full pass with solid timing. Keep starting the turn ahead of the buoy.

fail_note.text: Turns tended late, early, or unfinished. Begin earlier and finish the arc before loading the rope.

plan_tip.text: One steady edge through both wakes — stay stacked and keep the line tight after the second wake.

success_note.text: Line stayed tight through the crossings. Keep that same edge commitment next pass.

fail_note.text: Edge wavered, slack showed, or the pass ended in a fall. Commit to one edge and ease the pull more gradually.

plan_tip.text: Same basics as a long line. Width comes earlier on a shorter rope — stay patient on the turn.

success_note.text: Full pass. Next rope step unlocked — keep the same basics at the shorter length.

fail_note.text: Stay at this length until the full pass is consistent. Start the move out sooner if width dropped.
